# src/runtime/core.ts

<!-- Generated by scripts/document-code.mjs. Edit source contracts, then regenerate. -->

[Source](../../../../src/runtime/core.ts)

The runtime API without the XR / AR modules: what a desktop page needs. `index.ts` adds the
XR exports on top, so importing this subpath (`@nabla/engine/runtime/core`) keeps the headset
code out of a desktop bundle.
